name: LOKESH
about: I'm **Lokesh**, a Computer Science student specializing in **AI & ML**. Python is at the center of my work, and I'm learning to build intelligent systems that turn ideas into useful software.

My public projects explore document retrieval, AI-assisted healthcare workflows, and thoughtful application interfaces. I'm developing my machine learning foundations while exploring **generative AI** and **agentic systems**.
offscreen: Away from the keyboard: photography, gaming, and noticing how things work.

projects.title: AI-FIRST CRM
projects.subtitle: Healthcare workflows & document context
projects.description: A React/FastAPI CRM with LangGraph intent routing, FAISS + BM25 hybrid retrieval, and model-based reranking over local PDFs. Includes PostgreSQL persistence, Redis caching, and dashboard updates. Its repository documents development and integration limitations.

projects.title: TRIP PLANNER AI
projects.subtitle: Constraints before recommendations
projects.description: A synthetic travel-planning prototype with editable trip details, deterministic filtering/ranking, and transparent flight/hotel cost breakdowns. Includes assistant integration code and tests; AI availability depends on backend configuration. Selections are simulations.

projects.title: HEALTHHACK
projects.subtitle: Health Hackathon 3.0
projects.description: A responsive healthcare-event website with typed content modules, a keyboard-accessible gallery lightbox, an event timeline, and reduced-motion support.

projects.title: STEREOVISION
projects.subtitle: 3D & motion / secondary exploration
projects.description: A Python CLI suite for stereo disparity, colored .ply point clouds, Harris/SIFT/ORB matching with RANSAC, and Farnebäck/Lucas–Kanade optical flow. Includes synthetic datasets, evaluation metrics, and unit/integration tests. Computer vision is a secondary exploration.
